metadata.query: What did Pinochet do to his political opponents?

final_answer: Augusto Pinochet, as the military dictator of Chile from 1973 to 1990, was accused of numerous human rights violations against his political opponents. During his rule, thousands were arrested, tortured, and killed or disappeared. The most infamous cases include the Caravan of Death (1973) where military intelligence units executed over a hundred people, and Operation Condor (a transnational campaign involving several South American dictatorships to eliminate political opponents). [Source: Encyclopedia Britannica]
